dependency_notes: Sequencing per spec D15. S1 (deps + client bootstrap + smoke proof) gates the run. S2-S17 build the new modules beside the old flow, unwired (each gated by typecheck + unit tests; harness tests where named). S18 is the single cut-over. S19 (FR-A7 integration story, owning AC-OBS-1..7, no owning_module) runs right after the cut-over and depends on every spanned story: S1, S3, S4, S5, S6, S8, S9, S10, S11, S12, S13, S14, S15, S16, S17, S18. S20-S23 verify privacy, rewrite unit tests, then delete old code. S24-S26 e2e; S27 removes smoke spec/hook; S28-S29 docs/ADR/counts/end gate. Dependencies: S3<-S2; S4,S5<-S3; S6<-S4; S7<-S6; S8<-S6; S9<-S2; S10<-S9; S11<-S8,S9; S12<-S8,S9,S10; S13<-S6; S14<-S11,S13; S15 independent; S16<-S1; S17<-S13,S16; S18<-S1..S17; S21-S23 after S18; S24-S26 after S23. Module ownership is intentionally shared across sequential stories for client (S1,S16,S17,S20), invitations (S8-S11), handlers (S4,S5), membership (S13,S14) and MarmotContext (S18,S21-S29 composition root and cleanup); the spec allows no parallel implementation, so there is no collision. INV-1 and others with e2e halves: e2e halves run in S24-S26. DEP-2/DEL-1 are deferred to S22 because old code imports the forks until then.
